title: Langfuse for Graph-RAG Operations
subtitle: A Traceable Evaluation Blueprint for Sentinel RAG Ops
description: A research-style blueprint for adding Langfuse observability and evaluation to a graph-and-vector RAG system: trace contracts, offline and online evaluation, operational metrics, privacy controls, and an evidence-based implementation roadmap.
highlights: A proposed trace schema for ingestion, retrieval, generation, and evaluation
A controlled experiment protocol covering retrieval, grounding, latency, cost, and reliability
Privacy-aware telemetry boundaries and an honest implementation roadmap

title: Sentinel RAG Ops
subtitle: From Documents to Connected Knowledge
description: Inside a graph-based RAG application: document ingestion, Gemini model integration, knowledge-graph retrieval, and the practical work of diagnosing provider and quota failures.
highlights: System architecture and the document-to-knowledge pipeline
Recorded local results, troubleshooting, and limitations
Privacy considerations and a roadmap for further evaluation
